note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS codes — the company is an actual shipper from Mundra/Nhava Sheva, not just a website claim. Note the declared HS 845710 (machining centres) does not match the observed export lines (84581100 lathes, 84596190, 84314310); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes. The company also imports used machine tools (Italy), i.e. it is a machine-tool maker/trader rather than a metallurgy/mining producer as the industry field claims. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts) could not be retrieved: web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) and registry pages (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned HTTP 403, tofler returned 404 for PAN AAIFT1112C. PAN AAIFT1112C is unverified — no public source confirmed it; revenue and domestic turnover left null rather than estimated. No evidence of domestic supply found in the sources reachable, but absence here is a data-access gap, not proof of no domestic sales.
